domains.name: Application
domains.covers: Launching and quitting Illustrator, preferences, workspaces, keyboard shortcut sets, plug-ins, help and account items.

features.name: About Illustrator
features.summary: Shows the version, build and credits of the installed Illustrator.

automation.notes: The DOM reports version and build; it does not open the About box. Read-only in the DOM: Application.version.

features.name: Accessibility features
features.summary: Keyboard navigation, UI scaling and related options that make the application easier to use.

automation.notes: Inferred: keyboard navigation and interface options for people using the app. no member in any held object-model version, no command id in commands.json and no community script reaches it; UI Scaling is a separate preference.

features.name: Application
features.summary: The running Illustrator instance as scripts see it: the root that holds open documents, presets, fonts, preferences and the current selection.

features.name: Beta log file
features.summary: Opens the diagnostic log file kept by beta builds.

automation.notes: Listed only up to 30.4.

features.name: Color Picker
features.summary: Dialog for choosing a color by spectrum, numeric values or swatches.

features.name: Debug Panel
features.summary: Internal diagnostic panel listed in the command data; not a documented user feature.

features.name: Discover panel
features.summary: In-app panel with tutorials, tips and quick actions that respond to the current selection.

automation.notes: Unresolved: commands.json has a Window > Learn command and the DOM has Application.showLearnPanelWithContent, but no source establishes that either opens the current Discover panel.

features.name: Find Extensions on Exchange
features.summary: Opens Adobe Exchange to find and install extensions for Illustrator.

features.name: About Generative Credits
features.summary: Opens information about generative credits and how features consume them.

features.name: Generative Al User Guidelines
features.summary: Opens Adobe's usage guidelines for generative AI features.

features.name: Illustrator Help
features.summary: Opens Illustrator's online user guide.

features.name: Home screen
features.summary: Start screen shown when no document is open, with recent files, presets and learning content.

automation.notes: Inferred: the Home screen is interactive start-up UI. Application.homeScreenVisible only reports (read-only) whether it is showing; no member in any held object-model version, no command id in commands.json and no community script reaches it beyond that.

features.name: Show the Home Screen When No Documents Are Open
features.summary: Preference that controls whether the Home screen appears when every document is closed.

automation.notes: Opens the General preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Delete keyboard shortcut set
features.summary: Removes a custom shortcut set or clears a single shortcut assignment.

automation.notes: Opens the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog; deleting a set or clearing a shortcut is done by hand there.

features.name: Keyboard Shortcuts
features.summary: Dialog for viewing and changing shortcut keys for tools and menu commands and saving them as named sets.

features.name: Export Text (keyboard shortcuts)
features.summary: Writes the active shortcut set to a text file for reference.

automation.notes: Opens the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog; Export Text is a button in it, pressed by hand.

features.name: Custom keyboard shortcut files
features.summary: Custom shortcut sets are stored as .kys files in the user's preferences folder.

automation.notes: Shortcut sets are chosen, saved and deleted only in the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog; no DOM member reads or writes .kys files.

features.name: Manage My Account
features.summary: Opens the Adobe account page for the signed-in user.

features.name: Export Settings
features.summary: Saves the user's preferences, workspaces and presets to a file to move them to another machine.

automation.notes: Unresolved: no command id for Edit > My Settings is in commands.json and no DOM member exports settings.

features.name: Import Settings
features.summary: Loads preferences, workspaces and presets saved with Export Settings.

automation.notes: Unresolved: no command id for Edit > My Settings is in commands.json and no DOM member imports settings.

features.name: Plug-ins
features.summary: Native C++ extensions loaded at startup from the Plug-ins folder and any additional plug-ins folder set in Preferences.

automation.notes: Plug-ins are built with the C++ SDK (menu, tool, Live Effect and file-format plug-ins); scripts cannot create them.

features.name: Anchor point and handle display size
features.summary: Sets how large anchor points, handles and bounding box handles are drawn.

automation.notes: Opens the Selection & Anchor Display preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it (an older published script reads integer keys "selectedAnchorMarkType", "unselectedAnchorMarkType" and "directionHandleMarkType", but no source ties them to the current size slider).

features.name: Animated Zoom
features.summary: Smooth, continuous zooming when GPU Performance is on.

automation.notes: Opens the Performance preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Anti-aliased Artwork
features.summary: Smooths vector edges on screen without changing output.

automation.notes: Preference key "antialias/graphic" (boolean) set through app.preferences. The script that lists this key also lists antialias/text and antialias/image; matching antialias/graphic to this checkbox follows from the key name and is not confirmed by a second source.

features.name: Automatically Save Recovery Data Every
features.summary: Interval at which Illustrator writes crash-recovery data.

automation.notes: Preference key "aiFileFormat/enableContentRecovery" (boolean) turns recovery saving on or off. No source establishes the key for the interval, which is set in File Handling preferences (FilePref).

features.name: Enable Background Export
features.summary: Lets exports continue while work goes on.

automation.notes: Opens the File Handling preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Enable Background Save
features.summary: Lets saving continue while work goes on.

automation.notes: Opens the File Handling preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Appearance of Black: On Screen
features.summary: Shows rich black and 100% K black either differently or identically on screen.

automation.notes: Preference key "blackPreservation/Onscreen" (integer) set through app.preferences. blackPreservation/Export holds the printing and exporting choice.

features.name: Brightness
features.summary: Lightness of the interface theme.

automation.notes: Preference key "uiBrightness" (real) set through app.preferences. Scripts read it to detect a dark interface (0.5 or below is dark).

features.name: Canvas Color
features.summary: Whether the canvas matches the interface brightness or stays white.

automation.notes: Preference key "uiCanvasIsWhite" (integer) set through app.preferences. A published script writes 1 for white and 0 to match the interface; an older script reads it as boolean.

features.name: Copy As SVG code
features.summary: Includes SVG markup on the clipboard when copying.

automation.notes: Preference key "plugin/FileClipboard/copySVGCode" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Constrain Angle
features.summary: Angle of the x axis used for drawing and Shift-constrained moves.

automation.notes: Preference keys "constrain/angle" (real), "constrain/sin" (real), "constrain/cos" (real) set through app.preferences. Scripts write the angle together with its sine and cosine.

features.name: Corner Radius
features.summary: Default corner radius for the Rounded Rectangle tool.

automation.notes: Preference key "ovalRadius" (real) set through app.preferences. Value in points.

features.name: Hide Corner Widget for angles greater than
features.summary: Hides the live-corner widget on corners flatter than a chosen angle.

automation.notes: Preference keys "liveCorners/hideCornerWidgetBasedOnAngle" (boolean), "liveCorners/cornerAngleLimit" (real) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Disable Auto Add/Delete
features.summary: Stops the Pen tool from switching to add or delete anchor points over a path.

automation.notes: Preference key "pen/disableAutoAddDelete" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Show Font Names in English
features.summary: Lists non-Latin font names in English in the font menus.

automation.notes: Preference key "text/useEnglishFontNames" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Font Preview
features.summary: Shows sample renderings of fonts in the font menus.

automation.notes: Preference keys "text/fontMenu/showInFace" (boolean), "text/fontMenu/faceSizeMultiplier" (real) set through app.preferences. The real key holds the preview size.

features.name: GPU Performance
features.summary: Uses the graphics processor to render the canvas.

automation.notes: Opens the Performance preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Gridline every / Subdivisions
features.summary: Spacing of the document grid and its subdivisions.

automation.notes: Preference keys "Grid/Horizontal/Spacing" (real), "Grid/Vertical/Spacing" (real), "Grid/Horizontal/Ticks" (integer), "Grid/Vertical/Ticks" (integer) set through app.preferences. Spacing in points; Ticks holds the subdivisions.

features.name: Guides color and style
features.summary: Colour and line style used to draw guides.

automation.notes: Preference keys "Guide/Color/red" (real), "Guide/Color/green" (real), "Guide/Color/blue" (real), "Guide/Style" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Show handles when multiple anchors are selected
features.summary: Draws direction handles even when several anchors are selected.

automation.notes: Preference key "showDirectionHandles" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Highlight anchors on mouse over
features.summary: Enlarges the anchor under the pointer.

automation.notes: Preference key "highlightAnchorOnMouseOver" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Undo Counts / history states
features.summary: How many steps the History panel and undo keep.

automation.notes: Opens the Performance preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Use Japanese Crop Marks
features.summary: Draws crop marks in the Japanese style.

automation.notes: Preference key "cropMarkStyle" (boolean) set through app.preferences, as a published trim-mark script does. Document.cropStyle takes CropOptions: Japanese, Standard.

features.name: Keyboard Increment
features.summary: Distance a selection moves for each arrow-key press.

automation.notes: Preference key "cursorKeyLength" (real) set through app.preferences. Value in points.

features.name: Use Low Resolution Proxy for Linked EPS
features.summary: Draws linked EPS files with their low-resolution preview.

automation.notes: Preference key "useLowResProxy" (integer) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Enable Missing Glyph Protection
features.summary: Prevents typing characters the current font does not contain.

automation.notes: Opens the Type preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it (a published script lists a boolean key "text/doFontLocking", but no source ties it to this checkbox).

features.name: Object Selection by Path Only
features.summary: Requires clicking a path rather than its fill to select an object.

automation.notes: Opens the Selection & Anchor Display preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it (a published script reads an integer key "hitShapeOnPreview", but no source ties it to this checkbox).

features.name: Paste Remembers Layers
features.summary: Pastes objects back into the layers they were copied from instead of the active layer.

features.name: Show Pixel Grid
features.summary: Shows the pixel grid at high zoom in Pixel Preview.

automation.notes: Preference key "Guide/ShowPixelGrid" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Fill New Type Objects With Placeholder Text
features.summary: Puts sample text into newly created type objects.

automation.notes: Opens the Type preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Use Precise Cursors
features.summary: Shows crosshair pointers instead of tool icons.

automation.notes: Preference key "usePreciseCursors" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Use Preview Bounds
features.summary: Includes stroke width and effects in an object's measured bounds.

automation.notes: Preference key "includeStrokeInBounds" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Display Print Size at 100% Zoom
features.summary: Makes 100% zoom match physical print size rather than pixel size.

automation.notes: Opens the General preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Real-time Drawing and Editing
features.summary: Shows artwork live while it is dragged or edited.

automation.notes: Preference key "LiveEdit_State_Machine" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Reset Preferences
features.summary: Restores all preferences to their defaults the next time Illustrator starts.

automation.notes: Opens the General preferences dialog; Reset Preferences is a button there and takes effect at the next launch.

features.name: Enable Rubber Band for
features.summary: Previews the next path segment while drawing with the Pen or Curvature tool.

automation.notes: Opens the Selection & Anchor Display preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Scale Corners
features.summary: Scales live corner radii in proportion when objects are scaled.

automation.notes: Preference key "policyForPreservingCorners" (integer) set through app.preferences. A published script writes 1 to scale corners and 2 not to.

features.name: Scale Strokes & Effects
features.summary: Scales stroke weights and effect values when objects are scaled.

automation.notes: Preference key "scaleLineWeight" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Scratch Disks
features.summary: Drives used for temporary data when memory runs short.

automation.notes: Opens the Plug-ins & Scratch Disks preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Show Tool Tips
features.summary: Shows tool names and shortcuts when hovering over controls.

automation.notes: Preference key "showToolTips" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Alignment Guides
features.summary: Shows guide lines along the edges and centres of nearby objects.

automation.notes: Preference key "smartGuides/showAlignmentGuides" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Anchor/Path Labels
features.summary: Labels anchors and paths under the pointer.

automation.notes: Preference key "smartGuides/showLabels" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Construction Guides
features.summary: Shows guide lines at chosen angles from anchors.

automation.notes: Preference key "smartGuides/showConstructionGuides" (boolean) set through app.preferences. The angles are held in smartGuides/angles0-5 and smartGuides/customAngles0-5 (real) with smartGuides/anglesCount (integer).

features.name: Object Highlighting
features.summary: Outlines the object under the pointer.

automation.notes: Preference key "smartGuides/showObjectHighlighting" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Measurement Labels
features.summary: Shows distances and coordinates while drawing and moving.

automation.notes: Preference key "smartGuides/showReadouts" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Spacing Guides
features.summary: Shows equal-spacing hints between objects.

automation.notes: Opens the Smart Guides preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Transform Tools (smart guides)
features.summary: Shows guides while scaling, rotating and shearing.

automation.notes: Preference key "smartGuides/showToolGuides" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: Snap to Point (preference)
features.summary: Distance at which a dragged point snaps to another anchor or guide.

automation.notes: Preference key "snapToPoint" (boolean) turns snapping on or off, as does the snappoint command. No source establishes the key for the snap distance, which is set in the Selection & Anchor Display preferences (selectPref).

features.name: Snapping Tolerance
features.summary: Distance at which smart guides capture the pointer.

automation.notes: Opens the Smart Guides preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it (a published script lists integer keys "snappingTolerance" and "smartGuides/tolerance", but no source says which one this field writes).

features.name: Transform Pattern Tiles
features.summary: Transforms pattern fills along with the objects that contain them.

automation.notes: Preference key "transformPatterns" (boolean) set through app.preferences.

features.name: UI Scaling
features.summary: Enlarges or reduces the interface independently of the operating system.

automation.notes: Opens the User Interface preferences dialog, where the setting is changed by hand. No published script or source establishes a preference key for it.

features.name: Units: General
features.summary: Unit used for measurements in panels, rulers and dialogs.

automation.notes: Preference key "rulerType" (integer) set through app.preferences; a published script notes that the new unit only shows after the Units preferences are confirmed or Illustrator restarts. Document.rulerUnits sets the unit of one document.

features.name: Appearance of Black
features.summary: Pane for whether pure black and rich black look different on screen and in RGB output.

features.name: Clipboard Handling
features.summary: Pane for the formats Illustrator writes to the system clipboard when copying.

features.name: Devices
features.summary: Pane for input devices such as pen tablets and the Surface Dial.

features.name: Preferences
features.summary: Dialog holding application-wide preferences, grouped into panes and searchable.

automation.notes: Most preferences have no DOM property; Preferences.set*Preference writes raw keys whose names our sources do not establish.

features.name: File Handling & Clipboard
features.summary: Combined File Handling & Clipboard pane used by older versions.

features.name: File Handling
features.summary: Pane for recovery data, background saving and exporting, recent files and linked file handling.

features.name: General
features.summary: Pane for general behaviour: keyboard increment, constrain angle, corner radius, scaling options and similar defaults.

features.name: Guides & Grid
features.summary: Pane for guide and grid colours and styles and grid spacing.

features.name: Hyphenation
features.summary: Pane for the default hyphenation language and exception words.

features.name: Performance
features.summary: Pane for GPU acceleration, animated zoom, real-time drawing and the number of undo states.

features.name: Plug-ins & Scratch Disks
features.summary: Pane for an additional plug-ins folder and the scratch disks used for temporary data.

features.name: Selection & Anchor Display
features.summary: Pane for how objects and anchor points are selected and how anchors and handles are drawn.

features.name: Slices
features.summary: Pane for slice numbering and the colour of slice lines.

features.name: Smart Guides
features.summary: Pane for which smart guides appear and how strongly objects snap to them.

features.name: Touch Workspace
features.summary: Pane for the Touch workspace on touch-screen devices.

automation.notes: AiCommandPalette lists it only through 30.4.

features.name: Type
features.summary: Pane for type defaults: size and leading steps, tracking, font menu behaviour and placeholder text.

features.name: User Interface
features.summary: Pane for interface brightness, canvas colour, tab behaviour and UI scaling.

features.name: Units
features.summary: Pane for the units used for general measurements, strokes, type and Asian type.

features.name: Exit
features.summary: Closes Illustrator, prompting to save any documents with unsaved changes.

automation.notes: On macOS the item is Illustrator > Quit Illustrator.

features.name: Screen reader support
features.summary: Accessibility support so screen readers can announce panels, controls and dialogs.

automation.notes: Inferred: operating-system accessibility integration. no member in any held object-model version, no command id in commands.json and no community script reaches it.

features.name: Sign In... / Sign Out
features.summary: Signs the user in to or out of their Adobe account.

features.name: Submit Bug/Feature Request
features.summary: Opens the page for reporting bugs or requesting features.

features.name: Support Community
features.summary: Opens the Adobe community forum for Illustrator in a browser.

features.name: Microsoft Surface Dial support
features.summary: Lets a Surface Dial adjust values such as zoom, undo and tool settings on Windows.

automation.notes: Inferred: operating-system hardware integration. no member in any held object-model version, no command id in commands.json and no community script reaches it.

features.name: System Info
features.summary: Shows a report of the installed version, operating system, GPU, memory and loaded plug-ins.

features.name: Touch Bar support
features.summary: Context-sensitive controls for Illustrator on MacBook Pro models with a Touch Bar.

automation.notes: Inferred: operating-system hardware integration. no member in any held object-model version, no command id in commands.json and no community script reaches it.

features.name: Tutorials / What's New
features.summary: Opens the in-app learning content and the list of what changed in the current release.

features.name: Updates
features.summary: Checks for application updates through Creative Cloud.

features.name: Manage Workspaces
features.summary: Renames or deletes saved workspaces.

features.name: Customize workspace
features.summary: Docks, groups, collapses and floats panels to arrange the workspace.

automation.notes: Inferred: docking, grouping and floating panels is direct manipulation. no member in any held object-model version, no command id in commands.json and no community script reaches it; saved workspaces are switched with Application.switchWorkspace.

features.name: New Workspace
features.summary: Saves the current panel arrangement as a named workspace.

features.name: Reset Workspace
features.summary: Restores the active workspace to its saved layout.

features.name: Save Workspace
features.summary: Older name for saving the current panel layout as a workspace.

features.name: Switch workspace
features.summary: Activates a saved or built-in workspace such as Essentials, Typography or Printing and Proofing.

domains.name: Documents
domains.covers: Creating, opening, saving, closing and configuring documents, including templates, presets, color mode and metadata.

features.name: Activate document
features.summary: Brings a chosen open document to the front.

features.name: Clear
features.summary: Deletes the selected objects without copying them.

features.name: Close
features.summary: Closes the active document, asking whether to save changes.

automation.notes: Document.close takes a SaveOptions value.

features.name: Close All
features.summary: Closes every open document.

automation.notes: Scripts close each document in Application.documents in turn.

features.name: Cloud documents
features.summary: Documents saved to Creative Cloud storage (.aic) that sync across devices and keep version history.

automation.notes: Save with Document.saveToCloud, open with Application.openCloudDocument, read the location from Document.cloudPath (members from the 2023 object models). Version history is not exposed.

features.name: CMYK Color
features.summary: Switches the document color mode to CMYK.

automation.notes: The menu command performs the change. Read-only in the DOM: Document.documentColorSpace. Document.documentColorSpace takes DocumentColorSpace: CMYK, RGB.

features.name: RGB Color
features.summary: Switches the document color mode to RGB.

automation.notes: The menu command performs the change. Read-only in the DOM: Document.documentColorSpace. Document.documentColorSpace takes DocumentColorSpace: CMYK, RGB.

features.name: Copy
features.summary: Copies the selection to the clipboard.

features.name: Copy (Secondary)
features.summary: Secondary shortcut slot for Copy.

features.name: Cut
features.summary: Removes the selection and places it on the clipboard.

features.name: Cut (Secondary)
features.summary: Secondary shortcut slot for Cut.

features.name: Delete objects
features.summary: Removes selected objects with the Delete key.

features.name: Document color mode
features.summary: Whether the document works in CMYK or RGB.

automation.notes: Document.documentColorSpace is read-only; File > Document Color Mode > CMYK Color or RGB Color switches it. At creation, DocumentPreset.colorMode sets it.

features.name: Document Info
features.summary: Panel listing document details: color mode, fonts, linked images, swatches, styles and object counts.

features.name: Document
features.summary: An open Illustrator file as scripts see it, holding artboards, layers, swatches, styles and all page items.

features.name: Document presets
features.summary: Starting a document from a category preset (Mobile, Web, Print, Film & Video, Art & Illustration) or a saved custom preset.

automation.notes: Read-only in the DOM: Application.startupPresetsList.

features.name: Unsaved changes state
features.summary: Whether the document has changes since it was last saved.

features.name: Document Setup
features.summary: Opens Document Setup to change units, bleed, transparency grid, type options and other per-document settings.

automation.notes: File > Document Setup ("document") opens a modal dialog. Its options that the object model reaches are set without it: Artboard.rulerOrigin, Document.convertToLargeCanvas, and the Edit Artboards button through Application.selectTool("Adobe Crop Tool") (set_document_setup); units, bleed and transparency grid only at creation through DocumentPreset (create_document_from_preset).

features.name: Duplicate objects
features.summary: Copies objects by Option/Alt-dragging or with the Duplicate command in scripts.

features.name: Adobe Express templates
features.summary: Finding and editing Adobe Express templates in Illustrator.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object-model version, no command id and no community script finds or opens Adobe Express templates.

features.name: File Info
features.summary: Opens the metadata dialog for editing XMP fields such as title, author, keywords and copyright.

features.name: Large canvas
features.summary: Documents can use a canvas ten times larger than the standard maximum for very large artwork.

automation.notes: Document.convertToLargeCanvas (object models from 2023) converts an existing document to the large canvas. No DocumentPreset property selects it at creation in the held versions.

features.name: New
features.summary: Creates a document from a preset or custom settings in the New Document dialog.

features.name: New (Ten-A spelling)
features.summary: Alternative capitalised command string for File > New recorded by an older community list.

automation.notes: The command string "New" opens the New Document dialog, which waits for the user. New documents are created without a dialog through Documents.add and Documents.addDocument (create_document, create_document_from_preset).

features.name: New from Template
features.summary: Starts an untitled document based on an Illustrator template (.ait) file.

automation.notes: Opening an .ait file with Application.open creates an untitled copy.

features.name: New File (No Dialog)
features.summary: Creates a document with the last-used settings without showing the New Document dialog.

features.name: Bleed (new document)
features.summary: Bleed values set when the document is created.

automation.notes: documentBleedOffset takes a rectangle of bleed values; documentBleedLink links them.

features.name: Orientation
features.summary: Portrait or landscape orientation of the new artboard.

automation.notes: DocumentPreset has no orientation property; orientation follows from width and height (landscape when width exceeds height).

features.name: Save Preset
features.summary: Saves the current New Document settings as a reusable preset.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object-model version saves a document preset, there is no command id and no community script does it; presets can only be listed (Application.startupPresetsList) and read.

features.name: Artboard layout
features.summary: How multiple artboards are arranged: grid by row or column, single row or column, left-to-right or right-to-left.

automation.notes: DocumentPreset.artboardLayout takes DocumentArtboardLayout: Column, GridByCol, GridByRow, RLGridByCol, RLGridByRow, RLRow, Row.

features.name: Artboard rows or columns
features.summary: Number of rows or columns used by the artboard layout.

features.name: Artboard spacing
features.summary: Gap between artboards when the document has more than one.

features.name: Artboards
features.summary: Number of artboards the new document starts with.

features.name: Color Mode
features.summary: CMYK or RGB color mode of the new document.

automation.notes: DocumentPreset.colorMode takes DocumentColorSpace: CMYK, RGB.

features.name: Height
features.summary: Artboard height of the new document.

features.name: Name
features.summary: Name given to the new untitled document.

features.name: Preview Mode
features.summary: Initial preview mode: default, pixel or overprint.

automation.notes: DocumentPreset.previewMode takes DocumentPreviewMode: DefaultPreview, OverprintPreview, PixelPreview.

features.name: Raster Effects
features.summary: Resolution used for raster effects: screen (72), medium (150) or high (300 ppi).

automation.notes: DocumentPreset.rasterResolution takes DocumentRasterResolution: HighResolution, MediumResolution, ScreenResolution.

features.name: Transparency grid
features.summary: Initial transparency grid colours of the new document.

automation.notes: DocumentPreset.transparencyGrid takes DocumentTransparencyGrid: TransparencyGridBlue, TransparencyGridDark, TransparencyGridGreen, TransparencyGridLight, TransparencyGridMedium, TransparencyGridNone, TransparencyGridOrange, TransparencyGridPurple, TransparencyGridRed.

features.name: Units
features.summary: Measurement unit of the new document.

automation.notes: DocumentPreset.units takes RulerUnits: Centimeters, Inches, Millimeters, Picas, Pixels, Points, Qs, Unknown.

features.name: Width
features.summary: Artboard width of the new document.

features.name: Navigate to Next Document
features.summary: Activates the next open document window.

features.name: Navigate to Next Document Group
features.summary: Moves focus to the next group of tabbed documents.

features.name: Open
features.summary: Opens an existing file in a supported format.

automation.notes: Application.open takes a File and optional color space and OpenOptions; the menu command shows the Open dialog.

features.name: Add to recent files
features.summary: Whether a file opened by script appears in the recent files list.

features.name: Convert crop area to artboard
features.summary: Turns the crop area of a pre-CS4 document into an artboard.

features.name: Document units

automation.notes: Document.rulerUnits is read-only. The document's unit changes only in Document Setup (command "document", opens a dialog). The general unit preference uses key "rulerType" via setIntegerPreference; the ChangerUnites community script sets it and then opens Document Setup for the current document. Set only in File > Document Setup, whose command ("document") opens a modal dialog. Document.rulerUnits is read-only in every held object-model version. The general units preference (key "rulerType") is application-wide; the published ChangerUnites script sets it and then still opens Document Setup for the open document. DocumentPreset.units sets the unit of a new document.

features.name: Save as Template

automation.notes: File > Save as Template ("saveastemplate") opens a save dialog. Overlaps illustrator.import_export.save_ait.

features.name: Save a Copy

features.name: Bleed

automation.notes: No Document member sets bleed after creation. Document Setup is reached only through the File > Document Setup command (id "document"), which opens the modal dialog; the value is then set by the user. At creation, DocumentPreset.documentBleedOffset sets it. Set only in File > Document Setup, whose command ("document") opens a modal dialog. No Document member holds the bleed after creation. DocumentPreset.documentBleedOffset (object models 2023 and later) sets it when a document is created.

features.name: Discard White Overprint

automation.notes: No member in any held object-model version. Document Setup is reached only through the File > Document Setup command (id "document"), which opens the modal dialog; the value is then set by the user. Set only in File > Document Setup, whose command ("document") opens a modal dialog. No member in any held object-model version. Overprint on individual items is set through PathItem.fillOverprint and strokeOverprint instead.

No Document member holds the document flattener preset. For one print job, PrintFlattenerOptions sets flattening (print_document).

features.name: Double and single quotes

automation.notes: No member in any held object-model version. domains.name: Artboards
domains.covers: Creating, sizing, arranging, naming and exporting the artboards that make up a document's pages.

features.name: New Artboard
features.summary: Adds an artboard to the document.

features.name: Align and distribute artboards
features.summary: Aligns or evenly spaces selected artboards.

automation.notes: No command id aligns artboards; a script computes and assigns new rectangles. Document.rearrangeArtboards lays all artboards out in a grid.

features.name: Artboard background color
features.summary: Fills artboards with a colour on screen.

automation.notes: No DOM member or command id. AIArtboardSuite GetColor / SetColor set an artboard's colour.

features.name: Artboard context menu
features.summary: Right-click menu for an artboard with commands such as duplicate, delete and rename.

automation.notes: Inferred: right-click menu on the canvas. no member in any held object-model version, no command id in commands.json and no community script reaches it; its commands are reached separately.

features.name: Cut, copy and paste artboards
features.summary: Moves or copies artboards and their content within or between documents.

automation.notes: No artboard clipboard in the DOM; a script recreates the artboard with Artboards.add and duplicates its artwork, including into another document's layer.

features.name: Artboard display settings
features.summary: Display marks and fading controls for artboards.

automation.notes: Display marks are Artboard properties. Preference keys "ArtboardBBColorRed", "ArtboardBBColorGreen", "ArtboardBBColorBlue", "ArtboardBBWidth" (real) and "showArtboardLabelOnCanvas" (boolean) set the border and label, as a published script does. No source establishes a key for fading outside the artboard. Claimed by set_artboard_display: display marks through Artboard.showCenter, showCrossHairs and showSafeAreas, and border colour, border width and on-canvas names through the application preference keys ArtboardBBColorRed/Green/Blue (0-1), ArtboardBBWidth (1-4) and showArtboardLabelOnCanvas, as the cited published script sets them. Limit: no source establishes a preference key for Fade region outside artboard, so it is not offered.

features.name: Export artboards
features.summary: Exports artboards individually or as a range to image, PDF or SVG files.

features.name: Lock artboard
features.summary: Prevents an artboard from being moved or resized.

automation.notes: Unresolved: no Artboard member, command id or published preference key locks an artboard, and AIArtboardSuite's listed functions do not name a lock.

features.name: Move artboard
features.summary: Repositions an artboard, optionally carrying its artwork along.

features.name: Artboard
features.summary: A page-like region of the canvas with its own name, bounds and ruler origin; a document holds up to 1,000.

features.name: Artboard Options
features.summary: Dialog for an artboard's preset size, dimensions, position, orientation and display marks.

automation.notes: The dialog's name, size, position and display-mark fields are Artboard properties; no command opens the dialog. Orientation is set by swapping width and height in artboardRect (or the Switch Orientation command).

features.name: Video Ruler Pixel Aspect Ratio
features.summary: Pixel aspect ratio used for the artboard's video rulers.

features.name: Reorder artboards
features.summary: Changes the numbering order of artboards, which sets their page order on export.

automation.notes: No reorder member; a script re-inserts artboards at the wanted index with Artboards.insert and removes the old ones, copying their names.

features.name: Artboard ruler origin
features.summary: Zero point of an artboard's rulers.

automation.notes: Claimed by set_artboard_display through Artboard.rulerOrigin. The reference describes the value as relative to the artboard's bottom-left, but a published script sets [0, artboardHeight] to move the origin to the bottom-left (the pre-CS5 default), which means it is measured from the top-left with y down; the tool follows that script. Not yet confirmed in Illustrator.

features.name: Show Center Mark

features.name: Show Cross Hairs

features.name: Video display options

features.name: Artboard views

features.name: Artboards panel

features.name: Duplicate Artboards

features.name: Select artboards

features.name: Show / Hide Artboards

features.name: Switch Orientation

features.name: Bring to Front

features.name: Collect in New Layer

features.name: Layer stacking order

features.name: Layers

features.name: Panel Options (Layers)

features.name: Select faces and edges in Live Paint groups
features.summary: Selecting regions and edges inside Live Paint groups.

automation.notes: Application.selectTool("Adobe Planar Face Select Tool") activates the tool (id from AiCommandPalette's tool list; selectTool is in the 2023+ object models); drawing or dragging with it stays interactive. This is the Live Paint Selection tool; Live Paint groups are plugin art and their faces and edges are not exposed to scripts.

features.name: All Artwork Above
features.summary: Locks all artwork stacked above the selection.

features.name: Lock Others
features.summary: Locks all artwork except the selection.

features.name: Selection
features.summary: Locks the selected objects so they cannot be selected or edited.

features.name: Magic Wand
features.summary: Panel with the attributes and tolerances the Magic Wand tool matches.

automation.notes: "AI Magic Wand" (Window > Magic Wand) only shows the panel. None of its checkboxes, tolerances or the Use All Layers option has an object-model member or known preference key, so a script can open it but cannot read or set it. select_similar_items reproduces the Stroke Weight, Opacity and Blending Mode matches through the object model instead.

features.name: Magic Wand Tool
features.summary: Selects objects whose fill, stroke, opacity or blending mode resembles the clicked object.

automation.notes: Application.selectTool("Adobe Magic Wand Tool") activates the tool (id from AiCommandPalette's tool list; selectTool is in the 2023+ object models); drawing or dragging with it stays interactive. Clicking to sample is interactive; the Select > Same commands give exact-match selection without tolerance.

features.name: Blending Mode (Magic Wand)
features.summary: Matches objects that use the same blending mode.

automation.notes: The option is a checkbox in the Magic Wand panel and is set there by the user; no member or preference key is known. Select > Same > Blending Mode selects the same matches.

features.name: Fill Color (Magic Wand)
features.summary: Matches objects whose fill colour is within the tolerance.

automation.notes: The option is a checkbox in the Magic Wand panel (opened by "AI Magic Wand") and is set there by the user; no member or preference key is known. Select > Same > Fill Color selects exact matches, without tolerance. Matching fill colour within a tolerance has no command or member: the panel option cannot be set by script, and Adobe does not publish how the colour tolerance is measured. Adobe's community answer describes a per-channel window, but a user's test in the same thread shows colours inside that window left unselected, so a per-channel comparison through the object model would not reproduce Illustrator's result. Select > Same > Fill Color (select_same) matches exactly, without tolerance.

features.name: Opacity (Magic Wand)
features.summary: Matches objects whose opacity is within the tolerance.

automation.notes: The option is a checkbox in the Magic Wand panel and is set there by the user; no member or preference key is known. Select > Same > Opacity selects exact matches.

features.name: Stroke Color (Magic Wand)
features.summary: Matches objects whose stroke colour is within the tolerance.

automation.notes: The option is a checkbox in the Magic Wand panel and is set there by the user; no member or preference key is known. Select > Same > Stroke Color selects exact matches. As for Fill Color: the panel option has no member, and the colour tolerance rule is unpublished and not a plain per-channel window, so it cannot be reproduced faithfully. Select > Same > Stroke Color (select_same) matches exactly.

features.name: Stroke Weight (Magic Wand)
features.summary: Matches objects whose stroke weight is within the tolerance.

automation.notes: The option is a checkbox in the Magic Wand panel and is set there by the user; no member or preference key is known. Select > Same > Stroke Weight selects exact matches.

features.name: Tolerance (Magic Wand)
features.summary: Range of difference the Magic Wand accepts for each attribute.

automation.notes: Tolerance values are set in the Magic Wand panel by the user; no member or preference key is known. The panel's tolerance values have no member or preference key. select_similar_items takes its own tolerances for stroke weight (points) and opacity (percent) and compares PathItem.strokeWidth and PageItem.opacity, which are plain numeric differences; colour tolerance (0-255 RGB, 0-100 CMYK) follows an unpublished rule and is not reproduced, so the setting as a whole is not claimed.

features.name: Select nested objects and groups

features.name: Path segment selection

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object-model version (2022-2025), no command id in commands.json and no community script in the corpus reaches it. It is a modifier held during an on-canvas marquee drag; a script selects by setting PageItem.selected and has no marquee.

Scripts select and move objects without the tool (PageItem.selected, Document.selection, PageItem.translate).

automation.notes: "Selection Hat 14" (Select > Update Selection) opens no dialog, but it overwrites whichever saved selection the user last chose from the Select menu or the Layers panel. A script cannot choose, list or load a saved selection (the per-name Select menu items have no known command ids and there is no object-model member), so a tool could not say or control which saved selection it replaces. Not offered as a tool.

domains.name: Geometry
domains.covers: Paths, anchor points and segments: drawing them, editing them and combining them with path and pathfinder operations.

features.name: Add Anchor Point Tool
features.summary: Adds an anchor where you click on a path.

automation.notes: Activating the tool: AiCommandPalette uses app.selectTool('Adobe Add Anchor Point Tool'), which is not in the 2022 type definitions; selecting a tool does not perform its interactive drag. The DOM creates or changes the same result without the tool. Correction: Application.selectTool is in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 object models (it is missing only from the 2022 typings), so a script can activate this tool by id; drawing with it stays interactive.

features.name: Add Anchor Points
features.summary: Adds an anchor midway along every segment of the selected paths.

features.name: Anchor point
features.summary: A point on a path with optional direction handles that shape the neighbouring segments; either smooth or corner.

automation.notes: PathPoint.pointType takes PointType: CORNER, SMOOTH.

features.name: Anchor Point Tool
features.summary: Converts anchors between smooth and corner and adjusts individual handles.

automation.notes: Activating the tool: AiCommandPalette uses app.selectTool('Adobe Anchor Point Tool'), which is not in the 2022 type definitions; selecting a tool does not perform its interactive drag. The DOM creates or changes the same result without the tool. PathPoint.pointType takes PointType: CORNER, SMOOTH. Correction: Application.selectTool is in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 object models (it is missing only from the 2022 typings), so a script can activate this tool by id; drawing with it stays interactive.

features.name: Automatic addition and deletion of anchor points
features.summary: Pen tool behaviour that adds or deletes anchors when hovering over a path.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object-model version (2022-2025), no command id in commands.json and no community script in the corpus reaches it. It is a General preference for the Pen tool with no key named in any source.

features.name: Average
features.summary: Moves selected anchors to their average horizontal, vertical or combined position.

features.name: Average & Join
features.summary: Averages two end points and joins them in one step.

features.name: Clean Up
features.summary: Deletes stray points, unpainted objects and empty text paths.

features.name: Empty Text Paths
features.summary: Removes type paths with no characters.

automation.notes: A script removes text frames with empty contents itself; Clean Up opens the dialog.

features.name: Stray Points
features.summary: Removes isolated anchors.

automation.notes: A script removes paths with a single point itself; Object > Path > Clean Up opens the dialog, and Select > Object > Stray Points selects them.

features.name: Unpainted Objects
features.summary: Removes paths with no fill and no stroke.

automation.notes: A script removes paths with neither fill nor stroke itself; Clean Up opens the dialog.

features.name: Make
features.summary: Combines selected paths into one compound path.

features.name: Compound path
features.summary: Two or more paths painted as one object, with overlaps becoming holes.

features.name: Release
features.summary: Breaks a compound path back into separate paths.

features.name: Convert anchor points
features.summary: Switching anchors between corner and smooth with the Control panel or Anchor Point tool.

automation.notes: PathPoint.pointType takes PointType: CORNER, SMOOTH.

features.name: Copy paths
features.summary: Copying paths or path segments between documents and apps.

automation.notes: duplicate can copy into another document or layer; copy and paste go through the clipboard for other applications.

features.name: Create corner or smooth join
features.summary: Joins two selected end points with a corner or smooth anchor.

automation.notes: Object > Path > Join (or Average & Join) with two end points selected; choosing a corner or smooth join is interactive.

features.name: Curvature Tool
features.summary: Draws smooth curves by placing points, with the curve adjusting automatically between them.

automation.notes: Application.selectTool("Adobe Curvature Tool") activates the tool (id from AiCommandPalette's tool list; selectTool is in the 2023+ object models); dragging or clicking with it stays interactive. Smooth paths are built directly from points and handles.

features.name: Cut objects
features.summary: Cutting objects with the Knife, Scissors or Divide Objects Below.

automation.notes: Divide Objects Below cuts with a selected path; the Knife and Scissors tools can only be activated with selectTool ("Adobe Knife Tool", "Adobe Scissors Tool") and are used interactively.

features.name: Delete Anchor Point Tool
features.summary: Removes the clicked anchor while keeping the path connected.

automation.notes: Activating the tool: AiCommandPalette uses app.selectTool('Adobe Delete Anchor Point Tool'), which is not in the 2022 type definitions; selecting a tool does not perform its interactive drag. The DOM creates or changes the same result without the tool. Correction: Application.selectTool is in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 object models (it is missing only from the 2022 typings), so a script can activate this tool by id; drawing with it stays interactive.

features.name: Direction lines and points appearance
features.summary: How direction lines and handles are drawn on selected paths.

automation.notes: Preference key "showDirectionHandles" (boolean) controls whether handles show on selected anchors; a published script turns it on temporarily. Handle style and anchor size have no key in any source. Limit: only the boolean preference key "showDirectionHandles" is established. A published script turns it on so that handles show when several anchors are selected; set_preferences offers it as showHandlesOnSelectedAnchors. No source gives a key for handle style or anchor point size (Selection & Anchor Display), so those are not offered.

features.name: Divide Objects Below
features.summary: Uses the selected path as a cutter to divide the objects beneath it.

features.name: Drawing modes
features.summary: Draw Normal, Draw Behind or Draw Inside: where new artwork goes relative to the selection.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object-model version (2022-2025), no command id in commands.json and no community script in the corpus reaches it. The mode is a toolbar or Shift+D toggle; scripts place new art by stacking order (PageItem.move, zOrder) or clipping groups instead.

features.name: Angle

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object-model version (2022-2025), no command id in commands.json and no community script in the corpus reaches it. The Eraser Tool Options dialog opens by double-clicking the tool and has no command id; no source names a preference key for this value.

features.name: Roundness

The Eraser Tool Options dialog opens by double-clicking the tool and has no command id; no source names a preference key for this value.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object-model version (2022-2025), no command id in commands.json and no community script in the corpus reaches it. The Eraser Tool Options dialog opens by double-clicking the tool and has no command id; no source names a preference key for this value.

features.name: Stylus Wheel

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object-model version (2022-2025), no command id in commands.json and no community script in the corpus reaches it. The Eraser Tool Options dialog opens by double-clicking the tool and has no command id; no source names a preference key for this value.

features.name: Eraser Tool
features.summary: Erases any area of vector objects it is dragged across, splitting and closing paths.

automation.notes: Application.selectTool("Adobe Eraser Tool") activates the tool (id from AiCommandPalette's tool list; selectTool is in the 2023+ object models); dragging or clicking with it stays interactive.

features.name: Path as guide
features.summary: Whether a path is a guide rather than artwork.

features.name: Edit
features.summary: Changes which object is in front in an intertwined region.

automation.notes: Object > Intertwine > Edit ("Partial Rearrange Edit") changes nothing by itself. It puts Illustrator into intertwine editing, where the user clicks an overlap or draws around it to swap which object is in front. No object-model member chooses an overlap or its order, and no published Action records one. The SDK's AIIntertwineSuite (2025) is C++ only and only checks whether a group is an Intertwine.

features.name: Make
features.summary: Interlaces overlapping objects so they appear to weave over and under one another.

automation.notes: Limit: "Partial Rearrange Make" runs without a dialog and puts the selected objects in an Intertwine group, but the user still has to click or draw around each overlap to weave it. The intertwine tool claims Make only for creating the group. Not yet checked in Illustrator: whether executeMenuCommand returns while Illustrator waits for that overlap input.

features.name: Release
features.summary: Removes intertwining and restores the original stacking.

features.name: Intertwine Tool
features.summary: Draws around an overlap to bring part of an object forward or backward.

automation.notes: Application.selectTool("Adobe Intertwine Zone Marker Tool") activates the tool (id from AiCommandPalette's tool list; selectTool is in the 2023+ object models); dragging or clicking with it stays interactive. Object > Intertwine > Make starts the same mode on a selection.

features.name: Join
features.summary: Connects the open ends of selected paths, or closes a single open path.

features.name: Join Tool

automation.notes: Application.selectTool("Adobe Corner Join Tool") activates the tool (id from AiCommandPalette's tool list; selectTool is in the 2023+ object models); dragging or clicking with it stays interactive. Object > Path > Join joins selected end points without the tool.

features.name: Knife Tool

automation.notes: Application.selectTool("Adobe Knife Tool") activates the tool (id from AiCommandPalette's tool list; selectTool is in the 2023+ object models); dragging or clicking with it stays interactive. Object > Path > Divide Objects Below cuts with a selected path instead.

features.name: Make Pixel Perfect

features.name: Offset Path

features.name: Joins
features.summary: Corner style of the offset path: miter, round or bevel.

automation.notes: Apply the "Adobe Offset Path" live effect with applyEffect (Dict value "jntp": 0 round, 1 bevel, 2 miter, per the order of the cited script's list), then expandStyle to make real paths, as the cited script does. The Offset Path command instead opens the modal dialog.

features.name: Miter limit

automation.notes: Apply the "Adobe Offset Path" live effect with applyEffect (Dict value "mlim"), then expandStyle to make real paths, as the cited script does. The Offset Path command instead opens the modal dialog.

features.name: Offset
features.summary: Distance by which the new path is moved out from (or into) the original.

automation.notes: Apply the "Adobe Offset Path" live effect with applyEffect (Dict value "ofst", in points), then expandStyle to make real paths, as the cited script does. The Offset Path command instead opens the modal dialog.

features.name: Outline Stroke
features.summary: Converts strokes into filled outline paths of the same shape.

features.name: Path area and length
features.summary: Measured area and perimeter length of a path.

automation.notes: Both are read-only; area is in square points and negative for reversed paths.

features.name: Open or closed path

features.name: Path Eraser Tool

automation.notes: Application.selectTool("Adobe Freehand Erase Tool") activates the tool (id from AiCommandPalette's tool list; selectTool is in the 2023+ object models); dragging or clicking with it stays interactive.

features.name: Fill rule (even-odd / non-zero)

features.name: Path

automation.notes: Not a stored panel option for scripts: each "Adobe Pathfinder" effect applied with applyEffect carries its own ExtractUnpainted value (boolean, used by Divide and Outline), as the cited script builds it.

features.name: Precision

automation.notes: Not a stored panel option for scripts: each "Adobe Pathfinder" effect applied with applyEffect carries its own Precision value (a real number whose unit is not documented), as the cited script builds it.

features.name: Remove Redundant Points

automation.notes: Not a stored panel option for scripts: each "Adobe Pathfinder" effect applied with applyEffect carries its own RemovePoints value (boolean), as the cited script builds it.

features.name: Align

features.name: Horizontal Align Right

features.name: Align objects with a single action

features.name: Align To Selection

features.name: Vertical Align Top

features.name: Bounding box

features.name: Constrain (Free Transform)

features.name: Crystallize Tool

features.name: Vertical Distribute Bottom

features.name: Distribute objects by specific distances

features.name: Horizontal Distribute Center

features.name: Horizontal Distribute Space

features.name: Horizontal Distribute Left

features.name: Horizontal Distribute Right

features.name: Vertical Distribute Center

features.name: Vertical Distribute Space
features.summary: Makes the vertical gaps between objects equal.

features.name: Edit Contents

features.name: Expand

features.name: Make with Mesh

automation.notes: The only command, "Create Envelope Grid" (Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Mesh...), opens the Envelope Mesh dialog for rows and columns. The object model has no envelope class and no member that builds an envelope mesh; no published Action parameters exist.

features.name: Envelope
features.summary: Object that reshapes the artwork inside it to follow its own form.

automation.notes: Envelopes are created, released, expanded and edited only through the Object > Envelope Distort commands on a selection (Make with Warp and Make with Mesh open dialogs). features.name: Distort Appearance
features.summary: Distorts effects and styles with the object.

automation.notes: Set in the Envelope Options dialog, which Object > Envelope Distort > Envelope Options opens (applies to a selected envelope or to new envelopes); no object-model member or evidenced preference key. Set only in the Envelope Options dialog, opened by the "Envelope Options" command. No object-model member, evidenced preference key or published Action parameters reach it.

automation.notes: Set in the Envelope Options dialog, which Object > Envelope Distort > Envelope Options opens (applies to a selected envelope or to new envelopes); no object-model member or evidenced preference key. features.name: Preserve Shape Using
features.summary: Keeps raster shapes with a clipping mask or transparency.

automation.notes: Set in the Envelope Options dialog, which Object > Envelope Distort > Envelope Options opens (applies to a selected envelope or to new envelopes); no object-model member or evidenced preference key. Set only in the Envelope Options dialog, opened by the "Envelope Options" command. No object-model member, evidenced preference key or published Action parameters reach it.

features.name: Envelope Options
features.summary: Sets rasterization, fidelity and what an envelope distorts.

automation.notes: The only command, "Envelope Options" (Object > Envelope Distort > Envelope Options...), opens a modal dialog. No object-model member, evidenced preference key or published Action parameters set any of its options.

features.name: Release

features.name: Make with Top Object
features.summary: Uses the top object as the envelope shape for the objects below.

features.name: Make with Warp
features.summary: Distorts the selection with a preset warp shape such as arc, flag or fish.

automation.notes: The only command, "Make Warp" (Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Warp...), opens the Warp Options dialog. No object-model member creates an envelope, no preference key or published Action parameters set the warp style, bend or distortion, and the Warp effect (LiveEffect "Adobe Deform") is an appearance effect, not an envelope.

features.name: Free Distort

automation.notes: The tool mode is interactive (tool id "Adobe Free Transform Tool"). The same distortion is available as LiveEffect "Adobe Free Distort" applied with PageItem.applyEffect, whose Dict gives source and destination corners (R src0h, src0v, dst0h, dst0v through index 3); names come from community sources.

features.name: Free Transform Tool

automation.notes: Tool id "Adobe Free Transform Tool" (AiCommandPalette tool list) activates the tool; dragging stays interactive. Scale, rotate and shear are done directly with PageItem.transform and matrices; free distort with the Adobe Free Distort live effect.

features.name: Move
features.summary: Moves the selection by exact horizontal and vertical distances or by distance and angle.

features.name: Move with arrow keys
features.summary: Nudges the selection by the keyboard increment; Shift multiplies it by ten.

features.name: Move objects
features.summary: Dragging or nudging selected objects.

features.name: Attach
features.summary: Attaches the selected objects to the selected path and spaces them along it.

automation.notes: The only command, "Attach Objects on Path" (Object > Objects on Path > Attach...), is labelled as opening a dialog and attaching depends on choosing the path interactively; the Objects on Path tool ("Adobe Constraints Tool") is interactive. No object-model member attaches objects to a path, and no published script runs the command unattended.

features.name: Expand
features.summary: Turns objects attached to a path back into independent objects in place.

features.name: Options
features.summary: Sets spacing, offset, rotation and flip for objects attached to a path.

automation.notes: The only command, "Options Objects on Path" (Object > Objects on Path > Options...), opens a modal dialog for spacing, offset, rotation and flip. No object-model member, evidenced preference key or published Action parameters set them.

features.name: Objects on Path
features.summary: Attaches selected objects to a path and lets them be slid along it.

automation.notes: Tool id "Adobe Constraints Tool" (AiCommandPalette tool list) activates it; sliding objects along the path stays interactive. Object > Objects on Path > Attach does the attaching on a selection.

features.name: Perspective Distort
features.summary: Free Transform tool mode that moves corners symmetrically for a perspective look.

automation.notes: The tool mode is interactive. A script gets the same symmetric corner move by computing the four destination corners and applying LiveEffect "Adobe Free Distort" (keys src0h through dst3v) with PageItem.applyEffect.

features.name: Position and size
features.summary: X, Y, width and height of an object.

features.name: Pucker Tool
features.summary: Pulls anchors toward the brush centre, deflating the shape.

automation.notes: Tool id "Adobe Pucker Tool" (AiCommandPalette tool list) activates the tool; the brush stroke on the artwork stays interactive and no member performs the distortion. Effect > Distort & Transform > Pucker & Bloat (Live Pucker & Bloat) gives a related whole-object result.

features.name: Puppet Warp Tool
features.summary: Bends artwork by adding pins and dragging them, with the mesh following.

automation.notes: Tool id "Adobe Puppet Warp Tool" (AiCommandPalette tool list) activates the tool; placing and dragging pins stays interactive and no member performs puppet warping.

features.name: Reflect
features.summary: Reflects the selection across a horizontal, vertical or angled axis.

automation.notes: Reflection is a transform with a negative scale matrix.

features.name: Reflect Tool
features.summary: Flips objects across an axis through a chosen point.

automation.notes: Activating the tool: AiCommandPalette uses app.selectTool('Adobe Reflect Tool'), which is not in the 2022 type definitions; selecting a tool does not perform its interactive drag. The DOM creates or changes the same result without the tool. Correction: Application.selectTool is in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 object models (it is missing only from the 2022 typings), so a script can activate this tool by id; drawing with it stays interactive.

features.name: Scale by relative or absolute values
features.summary: Entering scale changes as relative amounts or absolute sizes in the Transform and Properties panels.

automation.notes: Relative scaling is resize with percentages; absolute sizing sets width and height (or computes the percentage). How the panels interpret typed values is UI behaviour with no member.

features.name: Reset Bounding Box
features.summary: Squares the bounding box back to the page axes after rotation.

features.name: Reshape Tool
features.summary: Moves selected anchors while stretching the surrounding path smoothly.

automation.notes: Tool id "Adobe Reshape Tool" (AiCommandPalette tool list) activates the tool; dragging anchors with it stays interactive. Anchors can be moved directly through PathPoint.anchor, without the tool's smooth stretching.

features.name: Rotate
features.summary: Rotates the selection by an exact angle.

features.name: Rotate Tool
features.summary: Rotates objects around a reference point; click to set the point, drag to rotate.

automation.notes: Activating the tool: AiCommandPalette uses app.selectTool('Adobe Rotate Tool'), which is not in the 2022 type definitions; selecting a tool does not perform its interactive drag. The DOM creates or changes the same result without the tool. Correction: Application.selectTool is in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 object models (it is missing only from the 2022 typings), so a script can activate this tool by id; drawing with it stays interactive.

features.name: Scale
features.summary: Scales the selection uniformly or non-uniformly by exact percentages.

features.name: Scale multiple objects
features.summary: Scaling several objects at once, each about its own centre.

automation.notes: Loop over the objects and call resize with scaleAbout Transformation.CENTER; Transform Each (Transform v23) does it through a dialog.

features.name: Scale Tool
features.summary: Resizes objects about a reference point.

automation.notes: Activating the tool: AiCommandPalette uses app.selectTool('Adobe Scale Tool'), which is not in the 2022 type definitions; selecting a tool does not perform its interactive drag. The DOM creates or changes the same result without the tool. Correction: Application.selectTool is in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 object models (it is missing only from the 2022 typings), so a script can activate this tool by id; drawing with it stays interactive.

features.name: Scallop Tool
features.summary: Adds curved, scalloped details along the outline.

automation.notes: Tool id "Adobe Scallop Tool" (AiCommandPalette tool list) activates the tool; the brush stroke on the artwork stays interactive and no member performs the distortion.

features.name: Shear
features.summary: Shears the selection by an angle along an axis.

features.name: Shear Tool
features.summary: Slants objects along an axis.

automation.notes: Activating the tool: AiCommandPalette uses app.selectTool('Adobe Shear Tool'), which is not in the 2022 type definitions; selecting a tool does not perform its interactive drag. The DOM creates or changes the same result without the tool. features.name: Transform Again
features.summary: Repeats the last transformation on the selection.

features.name: Transform Objects
features.summary: Applies the transformation to the objects themselves.

automation.notes: The changePositions argument of resize, rotate and transform is the Transform Objects choice.

features.name: Transform Patterns
features.summary: Applies the transformation to pattern fills.

automation.notes: The changeFillPatterns (and changeStrokePattern) arguments of resize, rotate and transform. The application-wide default is preference key "transformPatterns" (boolean).

features.name: Transform Each
features.summary: Scales, moves, rotates and reflects each selected object about its own reference point.

features.name: Move
features.summary: Horizontal and vertical offset for each object.

automation.notes: Transform Each opens its dialog; a script calls translate on each object instead.

features.name: Reference point
features.summary: Point each object transforms around.

automation.notes: The reference point corresponds to the Transformation value passed as scaleAbout or rotateAbout (TOPLEFT, TOP, TOPRIGHT, LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT, BOTTOMLEFT, BOTTOM, BOTTOMRIGHT, or DOCUMENTORIGIN).

features.name: Rotate
features.summary: Rotation angle for each object.

automation.notes: Transform Each opens its dialog; a script calls rotate on each object with its own rotateAbout point.

features.name: Scale
features.summary: Horizontal and vertical scaling for each object.

automation.notes: Transform Each (Transform v23) opens its dialog. A script gets the same result by calling resize on each object with its own scaleAbout point.

features.name: Transformation matrix
features.summary: Applies an arbitrary affine matrix to an object.

features.name: Transform panel
features.summary: Panel showing position, size, rotation and shear of the selection plus live shape properties.

features.name: Align to Pixel Grid
features.summary: Keeps the object aligned to whole pixels.

features.name: Constrain Width and Height Proportions
features.summary: Keeps width and height proportional when one changes.

features.name: Flip Horizontal
features.summary: Mirrors the selection left to right.

automation.notes: Transform with a scale matrix of -100 horizontally and 100 vertically (getScaleMatrix(-100, 100)).

features.name: Flip Vertical
features.summary: Mirrors the selection top to bottom.

automation.notes: Transform with a scale matrix of 100 horizontally and -100 vertically (getScaleMatrix(100, -100)).

features.name: Reference Point
features.summary: Point of the bounding box that the panel's values refer to.

automation.notes: The panel's reference point is preference key "plugin/Transform/AnchorPoint" (integer 0 to 8, top-left to bottom-right row by row, as ResizeToSize reads it). Script transforms take their own Transformation value instead.

features.name: Scale Corners
features.summary: Scales live corners with the object.

automation.notes: Preference key "policyForPreservingCorners" (integer): community scripts set 1 to scale corners and 2 not to, for Illustrator 17 and later.

features.name: Scale Strokes & Effects
features.summary: Scales stroke weights and effect values with the object.

features.name: Transform Both
features.summary: Transforms objects and their patterns together.

automation.notes: Pass changePositions and changeFillPatterns both true; the default for interactive transforms is preference key "transformPatterns".

features.name: Transform Object Only
features.summary: Transforms objects but not their patterns.

automation.notes: Pass changePositions true and changeFillPatterns false to resize, rotate or transform.

features.name: Transform Pattern Only
features.summary: Transforms pattern fills but not their objects.

automation.notes: Pass changePositions false and changeFillPatterns true to resize, rotate or transform.

features.name: Warp Tool

domains.name: Appearance

features.name: Add New Fill
features.summary: Adds another fill to the selected object's appearance.

features.name: Add New Stroke
features.summary: Adds another stroke to the selected object's appearance.

features.name: Add New Effect
features.summary: Opens the effect menu from the Appearance panel.

automation.notes: PageItem.applyEffect applies a Live Effect from LiveEffect XML (names used by published scripts include "Adobe Drop Shadow", "Adobe Offset Path", "Adobe Roughen"). The Effect menu items also have command ids. The panel button itself is not exposed.

features.name: Clear Appearance
features.summary: Removes all appearance attributes, leaving no fill and no stroke.

automation.notes: No command id, and setting filled/stroked to false in the DOM leaves effects in place. AIArtStyleParserSuite (RemoveAllEffects, RemovePaintField) with AIArtStyleSuite SetArtStyle clears it natively.

features.name: Duplicate Item
features.summary: Copies the selected fill, stroke or effect.

automation.notes: No DOM member or command id. AIArtStyleParserSuite (ClonePaintField, InsertNthPaintField, CloneLiveEffect) duplicates an appearance entry and rebuilds the style.

features.name: Hide Thumbnail
features.summary: Hides the thumbnail at the top of the panel.

automation.notes: Inferred: panel display option. no member in any held object-model version, no command id in commands.json and no community script reaches it.

features.name: New Art Has Basic Appearance
features.summary: Makes new objects start with a single fill and stroke.

automation.notes: Unresolved: panel menu toggle with no command id, DOM member or published preference key; no SDK suite in surfaces/sdk.json is shown to set it.

features.name: Redefine Graphic Style
features.summary: Updates the source graphic style with the current appearance.

automation.notes: No DOM member or command id. AIArtStyleSuite RedefineNamedStyle replaces a named style's definition.

features.name: Reduce to Basic Appearance
features.summary: Keeps one fill and one stroke and removes everything else.

automation.notes: No DOM member or command id. AIArtStyleParserSuite (RemoveAllEffects, RemovePaintField, CreateNewStyle) with AIArtStyleSuite SetArtStyle reduces a style natively.

features.name: Remove Item
features.summary: Deletes the selected fill, stroke or effect.

automation.notes: No DOM member or command id. AIArtStyleParserSuite RemovePaintField / RemovePreEffect / RemovePostEffect remove an appearance entry.

features.name: Show All Hidden Attributes

automation.notes: No DOM member or command id. AIArtStyleParserSuite SetEffectVisible / SetPaintFieldVisible / SetBlendFieldVisible make hidden entries visible.

features.name: Color, Gradient and None buttons

automation.notes: The buttons themselves are not exposed; a script gets the same result by assigning a solid colour or a GradientColor to fillColor/strokeColor, or by setting filled/stroked to false for None.

features.name: Custom arrowheads
features.summary: Adding user-made arrowhead shapes to the Arrowheads list.

automation.notes: Custom arrowheads are symbols kept in the Arrowheads.ai file in the application's support folder; a script can open that file, add a symbol and save it. Illustrator must be restarted to load the change; the folder path is platform-specific. A script could open Arrowheads.ai and save an edited copy, but the file lives in the application folder (Support Files/Resources/<locale>) and the edited copy must be saved into the application's Plug-ins folder, which is outside the server's path policy and usually needs administrator rights. The arrowhead symbols must follow construction rules that are only given as on-screen instructions inside the file, not in published documentation or scripts, and Illustrator must be restarted to load them. Not offered as a tool.

Object > Expand Appearance ('expandStyle', no dialog) is a different command, claimed by apply_effect and path_operation.
